t: Milwaukee M18 BPP2Q-402C 18V Twin Pack features a compact but powerful percussion drill and impact driver, with a high performance 4-pole motor, offering high torque with maximum power-to-weight ratio. Combi drill features a 2-speed gearbox and provides 60Nm torque, and the impact driver with full metal, 1/4" hex chuck delivers 180Nm torque for maximum performance. RedLink battery and overload protection help prevent damage under load, increasing system durability. Supplied with 2 x 4.0Ah RedLithium batteries, compatible with all Milwaukee M18 cordless tools, fast 80-minute charger, and durable blow-moulded case for easy transport and storage. Ideal for daily professional use.
